task.title: Add QUICKS collapsible section to VSCode extension sidebar
task.description: Add a new collapsible QUICKS section to the VSCode extension sidebar, positioned beneath the existing TASKS section. This section provides UI access to quick tasks stored in `.kanban/quick/{id}/` folders, with header buttons matching the TASKS pattern.
task.problem: Users cannot see or manage quick tasks from the VSCode sidebar. Quick tasks (used by `/kanban-quick`) are stored in `.kanban/quick/{id}/` but have no UI representation, requiring manual file navigation to access them.
task.value: Provides visual access to quick tasks directly from the sidebar, enabling faster workflow. Users can create, find, and access quick tasks without leaving the editor, matching the experience they have with regular tasks.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the VSCode extension is active and .kanban/ folder exists When the sidebar loads Then a QUICKS collapsible section appears beneath TASKS
Given the QUICKS section is visible When quick tasks exist in .kanban/quick/{id}/ folders Then they display as a flat list showing ID and title
Given a user clicks the '+' button in QUICKS header When the input box appears And the user enters a title Then a terminal opens and runs `/kanban-quick {title}`
Given a user clicks the Refresh button in QUICKS header When the button is clicked Then quick tasks are reloaded from .kanban/quick/
Given a user clicks the Find button in QUICKS header When the QuickPick opens Then quick tasks can be searched by ID or title And selecting a quick reveals it in the tree
Given a user clicks the Collapse All button in QUICKS header When the button is clicked Then all expanded quick items collapse
Given a user clicks a quick task item When the click occurs Then the corresponding quick.xml file opens in the editor
Given files change in .kanban/quick/ When the file watcher detects the change Then the QUICKS view auto-refreshes
